reconcile.note: Clarke reads the eleven's exclamation as tentative conjecture from Peter's return, not confirmed faith, consistent with Mark's report they still disbelieved the Emmaus pair.

sides.snippet: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn't believe them, either.
sides.verseText: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn't believe them, either.

sides.snippet: The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!
sides.verseText: saying, \"The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!\"
